examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Inside a `Field`: the trigger shows the selected country and its dial code, the list filters as you type, and `phone-change` hands over the E.164 number and whether it is complete.

examples.name: DefaultCountry
examples.summary: `default-country` starts the field on another country (here the United Kingdom) without binding `v-model:country`; the field starts on the United States when it is not set.
